name: Triangle Carriers Are Maximum Rank-One Trees in VC Dimension Three
statement: Let $H\subseteq Q_E$ be ample of VC dimension at most three and fix a shattered pair $S$. For $L_S=\{e:S\cup\{e\}\in\operatorname{Sh}(H)\}$, the family of placements of contained $S$-cubes, after deleting constants, is a maximum VC-dimension-one class on $L_S$. Its one-inclusion graph is a tree on $|L_S|+1$ vertices with one edge in each direction. The edge in direction $e$ represents the unique cube on $S\cup\{e\}$; either endpoint is nonleaf exactly when its corresponding $S$-facet belongs to another maximal three-cube. For a maximum VC-three class the carrier tree has $|E|-1$ vertices and $|E|-2$ edges.
proof: A support is shattered or strongly shattered by the carrier exactly when adjoining $S$ gives the corresponding property in $H$. Ampleness and the rank bound make its shattered complex the empty face plus the singletons in $L_S$, so it has $|L_S|+1$ members. Connectedness supplies a spanning tree; every active direction must occur, exhausting its $|L_S|$ edges and excluding additional edges. The definition of the carrier identifies directional edges with the unique three-cubes and adjacency at an endpoint with extension of that facet into another maximal cube.
